_note: Single authority for every visual block. The Director prompt, the validator and the compiler are all built from this file. To change a block, change it here and in its HTML file together.

safe_band_px._why: Instagram/TikTok draw their own UI above 168 px and below 1330 px; every word must sit inside this band.

placeholders.__ID__: the instance id (host id = scene root id = timeline key; HyperFrames requires all three to match)
placeholders.<!--GROUPS-->: captions only: the timed caption groups written by the compiler

face_cut.label: Talking head (a cut of the proxy)
face_cut.purpose: The speaker. Every second of the reel has a face_cut under it, except full-screen cards.

cy.help: zoom centre y (0-1); keep the face high

captions.label: Word-pop captions (Arabic, 1-3 words)
captions.purpose: Every spoken word, in groups of up to 3, built from the transcript by the compiler. The Director only chooses keyword word indices.

groups.help: compiler writes groups from transcript words; keywords turn lime + heavier + pop

hook_two_tone.label: Hook title, two tones (white line + lime line)
hook_two_tone.purpose: Frame 0 must already show the hook. Used once, at the very start.

line2.help: lime line on the violet bar, the strongest word(s)

text_card.label: Kinetic text card (full screen)
text_card.purpose: A chapter title or key claim. Hides the face; voice continues underneath.
rules: chapter card every 15-20 s on long reels

split.label: Split: card on top, face below
split.purpose: Shows a number or short point while the face stays visible (face moves to the lower half).

value.help: a number exactly as spoken (Western digits), or empty

label.help: what the number or point is

rules: value only if the number is actually spoken

flash.label: Lime flash + one word/number
flash.purpose: The payoff moment. Full-screen lime, one big dark word or number.

word.help: one word or number, as spoken

logo_card.label: Logo card (one logo, or a pair)
logo_card.purpose: Names a tool/brand/platform when he says it. Logos only from the reel's assets/ folder.

logo_a.help: file in the job's assets/ folder

rules: logo must exist in job assets/

cta_card.label: CTA card (last beat; one version per platform)
cta_card.purpose: The ending: follow (default) or comment-a-keyword. Over the face with a dark scrim. Handle appears only here.

promise.help: the reason to follow / what they get

keyword.help: comment keyword, only for comment-CTA reels

name_tag.label: Name tag (small, face stays visible)
name_tag.purpose: A small name/role tag at the top while he speaks. Use only when he says a name (a person, a brand, a place) out loud. The face stays visible.

name.help: the name exactly as he said it

role.help: optional: what it is (role or topic), his words

rules: only a name he actually said

info_card.label: Info card (lower third, face stays visible)
info_card.purpose: A floating card above the captions with one headline and one short explanation of what he is saying. The face stays visible.

number_graph.label: Number with a bar (full screen)
number_graph.purpose: A spoken number or percentage shown big with a filling bar. Hides the face; voice continues.

value.help: the number exactly as he said it, Western digits

label.help: what the number is, his words

percent.help: 0-100: ONLY if he said a percentage, else leave empty

rules: number must be one he said

before_after.label: Before / after (full screen)
before_after.purpose: Two cards: how it was and how it became. Hides the face; voice continues.
rules: both sides come from what he said

tier_list.label: Tier list S/A/B/C (full screen)
tier_list.purpose: A ranking he spoke out loud: up to four items in tiers S, A, B, C. Hides the face; voice continues.

title.help: what is being ranked, his words

rules: only items and order he actually said

ui_card.label: Floating app window (screenshot, face stays visible)
ui_card.purpose: A floating app/browser window above the captions that shows a screenshot from the reel's assets (or a simple dashboard drawing) with one short label. Use when he talks about a screen, a tool, a dashboard or an app. The face stays visible.

title.help: window title: the tool or page he names, his words

image.help: optional screenshot file from the reel's assets/ (no file = a simple dashboard drawing)

rules: image must be a file in the reel's assets/

doc_card.label: Document card (paper sheet with a highlighted phrase)
doc_card.purpose: A floating paper document above the captions with a title and ONE highlighted phrase from what he says. Use for a rule, a plan, a contract, a checklist or any 'written down' idea. The face stays visible.

highlight.help: the phrase to highlight, his exact words

pixel_scene.label: Pixel-art scene (full screen)
pixel_scene.purpose: A full-screen pixel-art picture that illustrates who or what he is talking about: a marketing department, a social media manager at work, or a team meeting. Use it to make a topic visual when there is no screenshot or number. The face is hidden and captions pause.

scene.help: marketing_department = a team with charts; social_manager = one person with phone, calendar and likes; meeting = people talking around a table

headline.help: what it is about, his words

rules: two full-screen moments need face time between them

text_behind.label: Text behind the head (big word, the head covers part of it)
text_behind.purpose: ONE big punchy word he says, shown huge BEHIND his head: his head and shoulders stay in front of the letters (made with an automatic person cutout). Use for the single most important keyword. Maximum 2 per reel. It needs a clear face in the middle of the frame and no zoom during it (the editor removes the zoom by itself).

text.help: one short word (or two), exactly as he says it

matte.help: the person cutout video, made by the compile step

top.help: text height in px, set from the face position

rules: needs the face in the middle of the frame

pack_frame.label: Format Pack frame (header, face window, step panel)
pack_frame.purpose: Format Pack only (made by the compiler, never chosen by the director): the persistent frame of an explainer reel.

groups.help: the step strip, written by the compiler from the outline

recap_chain.label: Format Pack recap (the steps as a chain)
recap_chain.purpose: Format Pack only: the outline's section titles as a numbered chain near the end.

motion_card.label: Motion card (one checked Lottie animation)
motion_card.purpose: A short animated icon (check mark, bell, cart...) when he says the thing it shows. Only files that passed the motion check (library/assets/motion/).

motion.help: file name in library/assets/motion/ (must have passed the motion check)

label.help: optional short label, his own words

rules: motion must be a checked file in library/assets/motion/

stage_frame.label: Stage layout frame (dark stage, footage container, glow)
stage_frame.purpose: Made by the compiler for the 'stage' layout only (layouts.py); never placed by the director.

line_text.label: Plain text lines (over footage)
line_text.purpose: Plain text over him or in a zone: one or two lines, optionally with a bold headline or a bold number (Hesham's Figma symbols). Words he said only; a number only if he said it.
rules: use headline OR number, not both
never a number he did not say
